name: Jellyseerr
summary: Browse films and television, ask for what you want, and it appears in Jellyfin.
after_install: This is the one to use day to day. Open it, sign in with your Jellyfin account at http://jellyfin:8096, then add Sonarr at http://sonarr:8989 and Radarr at http://radarr:7878 under Settings — each needs its API key, found in its own Settings, General. Then you search for something, press request, and it turns up in Jellyfin.

storage.description: Jellyseerr's own settings, users and request history.
